about.title: About us
about.p1: WeCook was born from the idea of gathering everyday recipes in one place: family classics, improvised dishes and happy discoveries. Here you can save your recipes, organize your week with the meal plan and keep track of the ones you liked best.
about.p2: The project is developed as a learning exercise: the frontend and backend code are managed separately by the team.

contacts.title: Contact
contacts.intro: Do you have questions, suggestions or have you found a problem? Write to us, we'll reply as soon as possible.

sections.title: Data we collect
sections.body: To create an account we collect a username, an email and a password (stored encrypted). Personal details (first name, last name, address, phone) are optional and only used to personalize your profile.

sections.title: How we use your data
sections.body: The recipes, favorites and meal plans you create are visible only to you, except for the recipes you choose to make public or visible to friends.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: You can update your data at any time from the Profile page, or ask for your account to be deleted by writing to wecook.support@gmail.com

terms.title: Terms of service
terms.intro: By using WeCook you agree to the terms below. If you don't agree, please don't use the service.

sections.title: The service
sections.body: WeCook is a platform to save, publish and share recipes, plan meals and interact with other users. The service is provided for educational purposes and may change or be discontinued at any time.

sections.title: Accounts
sections.body: To publish, comment or like you must sign up with truthful information. You are responsible for keeping your credentials confidential and for everything that happens with your account. You can enable two-factor authentication to protect it further.

sections.title: User content
sections.body: You remain the owner of the recipes, photos, videos and comments you publish. You grant us the right to display them on the platform according to the visibility you choose (public, friends only or private) and to translate them automatically. Only publish content that is yours or that you have the right to share.

sections.title: Automatic translations
sections.body: Recipes are translated into Italian, English and French with automatic tools. Translations may contain mistakes: the original text written by the author remains the reference.

sections.title: Acceptable behavior
sections.body: You may not post illegal, offensive, discriminatory or misleading content, send spam or impersonate other people. Moderators may remove reported content, send warnings, and suspend or ban accounts that break these rules.

sections.title: Health and allergens
sections.body: Recipes are shared by users and do not replace the advice of a doctor or a nutritionist. Always check ingredients, allergens, cooking and storage before eating a dish.

sections.title: Limitation of liability
sections.body: The service is provided "as is", without guarantees of availability or of being error-free. To the extent permitted by law, WeCook is not liable for damages arising from the use of the platform or of content published by users.

sections.title: Closing your account
sections.body: You can ask for your account to be deleted at any time by writing to wecook.support@gmail.com. We may suspend or close accounts that violate these terms.

sections.title: Changes to the terms
sections.body: We may update these terms: the date at the top shows the latest revision. By continuing to use WeCook after a change you accept the new version.
